_note: 800 m race model. Ability (1-20, from attributes) maps to an even-effort race time by gender, interpolated between these anchors. Calibrated against SUL youth skill-badge standards for 15-year-olds (taitomerkkirajat: boys 2:16 / 2:26 / 2:36, girls 2:33 / 2:43 / 2:53), SM 14-15 qualifying times (M15 2:21, N15 2:35), Kalevan kisat standards (1:53.50 / 2:11.00) and Finnish/world-class senior times. Ability 20 = world-class senior.

ability_weights._note: How much each attribute counts towards 800 m ability (sums to 1).

fields._note: Opponents per meet level: how many, and which part of the rival pool they come from (0 = weakest, 1 = strongest).

rivals._note: Fictional rivals of the player's age and gender (real youth athletes are minors, so they're not used). Ability at career start ~ N(mean, sd).

engine._note: Pack racing (GDD 4.3.1, step R1). Each runner has a cruising speed cs and a reserve (metres above cs); running behind someone costs less, the leader pays full price. cs_scale is the one calibration number: it keeps the median race time on the time table.
engine._drain: Reserve used per second above cs: (speed - cs) x (speed / the runner's even speed)^drain_power (R2). 0 = plain linear (R1). Even pace costs the same either way; above it the reserve goes faster, below it slower.
engine._draft: Drafting: up to draft_dist metres behind a runner in the same line (lateral gap under draft_lat) the cost is lower by `draft` of speed; diagonally behind (lateral gap up to draft_lat_max) x second_row; on a bend x bend.
engine._follow: Following: a runner within follow_range of the runner ahead runs that runner's speed, closing the gap to follow_gap (0 when running alongside in another line) at close_rate per metre, at most close_max x their speed.
engine._tuck: On a bend (or tuck_ahead metres before one) a runner alongside on the outside drops tuck_gap metres behind and moves in.
engine._hang: Hanging on: a runner follows while the reserve they FEEL they will have at their kick point is at least kick_need_per_100 x kick distance / 100 x reserve (less by `dig`: personality + (competitiveness - 10) x dig_per_point, up to dig_max). Otherwise they drop to the speed that keeps it (never below own_floor x the speed that would empty the reserve at the line). Dropped = more than drop_gap metres behind the runner ahead.
engine._misjudge: Each runner feels their reserve with an error (share of the reserve, fixed for the race), sd from at_1 (race tactics 1) to at_20 (race tactics 20). Kick timing noise in metres likewise.
engine._kick: The fastest a runner can kick at the end of an 800 m: their even speed x (kick_vs_even + kick_per_speed x (speed - ability)), at most kick_top_vmax x their top speed.
engine._place: The plan (the place a runner wants): speed in lanes before the break; until lead_until metres lead runners move up to the front and pack runners up to pack_place (if they have the energy for pass_speed). Anyone passes a runner slower than pass_margin x the pace the race should be going.

moves._note: Surges (GDD 4.3.1, step R2): after after_break metres past the break line a runner who is not kicking may surge: speed x speed range (of their speed or the race pace, whichever is higher) for a length in metres. Chance per 100 m: rate_per_100 by personality (surgers use surger.rate_per_100 between surger.from and surger.to metres run), x shape_mult, x leader_mult for the leader, x behind_mult when more than front_group metres behind the leader; at most max_per_runner each, and only when they feel the reserve for it is spare. Runners from 2 m ahead of the surger to react_range behind decide: cover (chance cover[personality or player], moved towards cover_smart[can't afford, can afford] by race tactics) or let it go (no faster than their speed then, or the race pace, until the surge is over + let_go_after metres). Covering: the surger's speed, closing up at most cover_max x it, digging cover_dig deeper.

chain._note: The kick chain (R2): when a runner starts their kick in the first front_pos places or within front_m metres of the leader, every runner from `ahead` metres in front of them to answer_range behind who is not kicking yet answers with chance answer[personality or player] (x early when it comes before their own kick point), moved towards smart[can't hold it, can] by race tactics: 'can' = the speed they could hold to the line is at least can_share x the kicker's. Answering = their own kick now when they have at most kick_now_share x their own kick distance to go, else going with the kicker (covering, as a move: they kick at their own point); a runner near the front who goes with it passes the decision on to those behind them.

box._note: Boxed in (R2): a runner who wants past (kicking, in a move, covering, or in the last urgent_to_go metres) with a runner under `gap` metres ahead in the same line and someone alongside on the outside runs no faster than the runner ahead and picks a way out (weights: wait = wait x (metres to go / wait_to_go, 0.2-2) x (1 + tactics); ease = ease + ease_skill x tactics; push = push + push_grit x (grit - 10), x push_late in the last `late` metres; tactics = race tactics as 0-1). wait: a gap opens with gap_rate per second (race tactics 1 to 20). ease: ease_speed x the speed of the runner ahead until the outside is clear (the box lasts up to `hold` metres behind). push: squeezes out for push_time s, contact with chance push_contact, obstruction DQ with chance push_dq.

contact._note: Contact (R2): a runner on someone's heels (under `along` metres behind, lateral gap under `lat`) has a contact with chance rate[where] per second: break = cutting in within break_zone metres after the break line, swing = either runner moving sideways, bend, straight. A contact: the runner behind is the one in trouble with chance victim_behind (else the one ahead); stumble with chance `stumble` (loses stumble_m metres and stumble_reserve metres of reserve), fall with chance `fall` (down fall_down seconds, fall_reserve metres of reserve, DNF with chance dnf; the runner right behind within brought_along metres goes down too with chance brought_down); the one ahead is spiked with chance `spiked`. rival_out: a rival who falls is out for `weeks` weeks with chance `chance` (dnf_chance after a DNF), applied when the health model is on.

heat_ease._note: Heats with automatic places (R2): a runner in an automatic place at least `margin` metres ahead of the first runner outside them eases to speed x their speed in the last `from` metres (rolled per runner).

engine._events: Race events (R2): a kick that empties the reserve with more than kick_dying_to_go metres left is 'kick dying'; a new leader counts as a lead change when the old one had led lead_change_s seconds; adjacent finishers under close_finish_s apart are a close finish, under photo_finish_s a photo finish.

controls._note: The player's controls in a watched race (GDD 4.3.1 'Player controls', step R3). Card texts and the coach's shouts: data/race_cards.json.

cards._note: Event-driven pause cards, at most `max` per race. `always` cards (break, bell, 200 m to go) are asked once each and keep their place in the budget; the others only while shown + always-cards-still-to-come < max, at least min_gap_s race seconds after the last card (no_gap kinds ignore that), at most max_per_race times, and (only_below) while fewer than N cards were shown, so the low-priority ones leave room for the important ones. priority = most important first when two want the same moment. bell_at (metres run; the 200 m card comes when the player reaches their own kick point instead of the kick starting by itself), straight_from + straight_gap: the home straight card needs a runner within that many metres ahead. box_after_s: a box must last that long before it is a card; box_move_m: a rival's move or kick from this far behind to this far ahead of the player counts as 'a move goes'. dropped: the gap to the runner ahead (m) and how long (s) before 'losing contact' is asked, not in the last min_to_go metres. slow: leader slower than pace_max x the field's even speed, between from and to metres run, player in the first max_place places and within group_m of the leader.

effort._note: The action bar's Push / Hold / Ease (and the bell card): the player's speed before the kick x this.

move_out._note: Move out: for `seconds` the player runs `lane` metres further out (at most max_lat from the rail) and goes for a pass on the outside.

counter._note: Counter-attack on a surge: the player's own surge at speed x their pace for length metres (against a kick: their own kick now).

chase._note: After a fall: Get up and chase digs `dig` deep and pushes; Finish steady eases off and kicks late.

bar._note: Kick now needs a second tap within kick_confirm_s real seconds.

feeling._note: The word under the clock, from the share of the reserve the player FEELS they have left (misjudged by their race tactics), minus fatigue_per_point per point of fatigue above fatigue_from. thresholds: from this share down to the next one gives the next word.

slow_motion._note: At 2x / 4x the race drops to 1x for `seconds` race seconds when one of these events happens within range_m of the player: `types` for any runner, `types_player` only for the player (a box is only a moment when it is yours: boxes are everywhere in a pack).

auto._note: Quick mode: the athlete picks the sensible answer with this chance (race tactics 1 to 20), else any of the answers.

sensible._note: What a sensible runner answers (the coach's advice, quick mode, the checks): bell - push when they feel at least bell_push_share of the reserve and are 3rd or worse, ease below bell_ease_share; counter when they feel counter_share, have counter_to_go or less to go and a kick at least counter_edge times the mover's; the kick card - go now when they feel at least kick_now_factor x the reserve an even kick from here needs; slow pace - take the lead when they are among the first slow_rank by even speed and feel at least slow_share; boxed - wait with more than box_wait_to_go to go, push through in the last box_push_to_go; dropped - dig in when they feel at least dig_share; fall - chase when the runner ahead is under chase_gap away.

coach._note: The coach by the track (a stand-in until R4 gives him a spot): outdoors he stands spot_outdoor metres round the lap and sees the player within view_m along the track; indoors he sees the whole track. He shouts the sensible answer with chance accuracy, otherwise another one. Shouts: data/race_cards.json.

shapes._note: Race shapes (GDD 4.3.1; tactical lap 1 made 8-12 % slower in step R2, user 2026-10-08: real tactical finals start ~10 % slower, so the kick decides): the leader's pace as a share of the field's even speed (the runner at pace_ref_quantile of the field by ability, 0 = strongest, 0.5 = median), lap 1 and lap 2 ranges. The mix per meet level / round in percent; a front runner in the field moves front_runner_shift points from tactical to fast, no front runner from fast to tactical.

personalities._note: Rival personalities (GDD 4.3.1), kept on the rival. weight = base + per_anaerobic x anaerobic (at least 0.02): low anaerobic -> front runner / surger, high -> kicker. want = the place they run for; kick_at = metres to go when they start their kick (range); dig = how deep they dig to hang on. Their surges and how they cover moves and answer kicks: engine.moves / engine.chain.
